column1: # What a row of the bar shows beside it: the row, the seat of the group
# (top, center, bottom), the group, then slug, label, icon, and what a
# press does. A `head` row is its group's heading. A `side` row has the
# group hold the host app.tsv calls `side`: the hosts the person joined
# with their rooms, which takes the room the other groups leave.
